title: A trading bot showing "running" doesn't tell me much
author: specter_spike
selftext:
I'm less worried about a bot throwing an obvious error than one that quietly stops checking the conditions it's supposed to watch.

A green status looks reassuring, but what if the last useful check was hours ago?

alphio has task statuses and execution logs, which help with reviewing what happened. I'd still want some kind of missed-run alert for anything time-sensitive, though.

A bot being online and a bot actually doing its job are two different things.
